"Malthus argued that prosperity could be increased only by controlling the growth of population. Malthus's predictions were proved false because food production grew faster than population in many European countries."

items.answer: (i) Liberal and Marxist scholars (ii) The branch of demography that studies the social, economic and political aspects of population. (iii) They argued that poverty and starvation are caused by unequal distribution of resources, not by population growth.
